messages:
support-alex: Heads-up — five separate support tickets this week asking for tenant-level model pinning and a clearer way to 'lock' a model for a tenant. All similar but slightly different asks from ACME, BetaCorp, DeltaApps, and two internal escalations. Can product help canonicalize?

maya.pm: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the ticket links and a short summary of differences? also, which ones have ARR / sales pressure?

support-alex: Links: https://tickets/ACME-1121, https://tickets/BETA-474, https://tickets/DELTA-981, INT-204, INT-205. Differences: ACME wants sticky model across restarts; Beta needs UI checkbox in Console; Delta wants API flag; internal asks are both for Dedicated customers, higher SLA. ARR: ACME ~$450k, Beta ~pilot (not signed), Delta ~$75k.

sam.sales: tagging here — ACME is in renewal conversations. if we don't show plan, risk delaying renewal.

maya.pm: Ok - priority based on ARR. ACME is priority. Proposal: create a canonical backlog ticket "REQ-523: tenant-level model pinning" and merge/support other tickets into it. We'll add sub-tasks for API, Console, Dedicated infra work. Thoughts?

olivia-triage: +1. I can merge the five tickets into REQ-523 and add links. I suggest adding tags: cust-merge, high-rev, api, console, dedicated. Also add "info-needed" to Beta if they want UI mockups.

request-tracker-bot: REQ-523 created by maya.pm at 1968001450. Linked tickets: ACME-1121, BETA-474, DELTA-981, INT-204, INT-205.

maya.pm: Next, scope negotiation: engineering can ship a minimal API flag to pin model (server-side lock) in 1 sprint, Console checkbox in 2 sprints, Dedicated infra changes may need capacity planning (engineers: @tom.eng). We should ask ACME if API-first is acceptable for renewal window.

tom.eng: API flag seems straightforward. Question: do we need migrations for existing served versions? If we add per-tenant pin, we need to store model_version in tenant config and ensure routers honor it. Estimate: 3 dev days + 2 QA days for API + integration tests. Console depends on design handoff.

maya.pm: Good. Proposed launch criteria for MVP: 1) API supports per-tenant model pinning (documentation + cURL example), 2) server honors pinned model in routing (no regressions), 3) smoke tests for performance impact, 4) communication plan to affected customers. If all OK, mark P1 for ACME.

sam.sales: For external comms to ACME, recommend we offer temporary workaround: we can apply pin on their behalf via support for short term. Also ask ACME if API-first is acceptable. I can coordinate outreach.

olivia-triage: I'll update REQ-523 with the proposed acceptance criteria and add a "reach out" checklist.

support-alex: Can we standardize the message we send to duplicate requesters when merging? I keep typing similar replies.

maya.pm: Yes — let's use a short template. Draft below, feel free to tweak:

```
Hi <name>, thanks for the request — we grouped similar customer asks into REQ-523 (tenant-level model pinning). We're tracking this as P1 for ACME and will share updates here. If you have specific requirements (UI vs API, performance SLAs, rollout timeline), please reply and we'll add to the ticket. We're also able to apply a temporary pin on your behalf — let us know if you'd like that.
```

olivia-triage: Nice. I'll use that when merging and add a note: "you are subscribed to updates on REQ-523".

tom.eng: One more engineering note: add a rollout plan and rollback steps. If we pin a model that later has a regression, we need an automated fallback to latest compatible variant. Otherwise ops churn.

maya.pm: Agreed — add fallback policy to acceptance criteria: automated fallback to `default-variant` if model health checks fail.

request-tracker-bot: REQ-523 tags updated: [cust-merge, high-rev, api, console, dedicated, p1]. Owner assigned: maya.pm.

support-alex: ACTIONS: Olivia will merge and notify requesters today; Sam will contact ACME to confirm API-first is ok and offer temporary support pin; Tom will prototype API flag and post ETA; Maya will finalize acceptance criteria and schedule kickoff.

olivia-triage: Done — merged tickets and pinged requesters with template. ACME replied: "API-first is OK, want ETA before renewal call."

sam.sales: I'll sync with ACME and push for a target delivery window.

maya.pm: Thanks team. I'll create a short RFC in docs/ and tag eng/runtime and console for visibility. We'll revisit priorities in next weekly roadmap sync. :thumbsup:
